about: The v1 card catalog (ADR 0005). tools/card_import.py writes each card's printed fields (id, number, name, type, corporate_era, cost, tags, requirements, victory_points, text, face) from the fan-made card list at ssimeonoff.github.io/cards-list, and rewrites them when run again. Any other field is written by hand and kept.
